# KEY DIFFERENTIATOR - THE DUAL-ENGINE MODEL
model: >
  The Dual-Engine Model is a closed-loop system. Enterprise contracts generate revenue.
  Operational costs are covered. Profit margins are legally mandated by our Trust deed
  to fund non-profit operations such as the B.A.R.C animal rescue platform, the R.U.N
  e-rickshaw battery programme, rural healthcare clinics, and educational initiatives.
  Public donations form an additional crucial backbone for philanthropic missions.
